question: 哪些邮件的收件人序号范围最大？分别计算每封邮件enron_emailto中的最大nthto和enron_emailxto中的最大nthxto，缺失时按0处理；列出两者最大值较大的前10封邮件，返回邮件ID、主题、最大nthto和最大nthxto，先按两者中的较大值降序、再按邮件ID升序排列。
generated_sql:
WITH all_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT id FROM enron_emailto
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT id FROM enron_emailxto
),
max_to AS (
    SELECT id, MAX(nthto) AS max_nthto
    FROM enron_emailto
    GROUP BY id
),
max_xto AS (
    SELECT id, MAX(nthxto) AS max_nthxto
    FROM enron_emailxto
    GROUP BY id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        a.id,
        COALESCE(t.max_nthto, 0) AS max_nthto,
        COALESCE(x.max_nthxto, 0) AS max_nthxto,
        GREATEST(COALESCE(t.max_nthto, 0), COALESCE(x.max_nthxto, 0)) AS max_val
    FROM all_ids a
    LEFT JOIN max_to t ON a.id = t.id
    LEFT JOIN max_xto x ON a.id = x.id
)
SELECT 
    c.id,
    i.subject,
    c.max_nthto,
    c.max_nthxto
FROM combined c
LEFT JOIN enron_emailinfo i ON c.id = i.id
ORDER BY c.max_val DESC, c.id ASC
LIMIT 10;
